body:
OpenMC – Official Roleplay Modpack

The OpenMC Modpack is the official modpack for the OpenMC Minecraft Roleplay server, built specifically to support deep, immersive, long-term roleplay. It enhances vanilla Minecraft with carefully curated mods that expand realism, interaction, and player expression while remaining stable and performance-friendly.

Key features include:

Immersive roleplay mechanics such as enhanced movement, animations, and realistic systems that make characters feel alive

Extensive decoration and building mods for detailed interiors, cities, shops, and roleplay locations

Economy and profession support, enabling businesses, jobs, and player-driven markets

Technology and utility mods that allow for modern infrastructure, automation, and quality-of-life improvements

Atmospheric enhancements including improved visuals, sounds, and environmental details to support storytelling

Performance optimizations and stability fixes to ensure smooth gameplay even in complex RP scenarios

This modpack is ideal for players who enjoy city roleplay, character-driven stories, social interaction, and collaborative worldbuilding. Every mod is chosen to support creativity, consistency, and immersive storytelling on the GateMC server.

⚠️ Required to play on the OpenMC server.
The modpack includes all necessary configurations and mods needed to connect and roleplay as intended.
